memories_after: [Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"os":"windows","project":"docs"}) File and content verification in the docs project is done with Windows PowerShell (powershell.exe), treating a successful run (exit code 0) as the pass condition.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) Agenium agent work in the docs project happens in a git worktree at .agenium/worktrees/AGN-<id> on branch agenium/AGN-<id>.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) The docs project is a git repo whose Agenium configuration lives in agenium.toml at the repo root together with README.md.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, team documents live in deliverables/ and reports/, alongside notes/ and artifacts/ directories.
[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, tickets stay Resolved after a successful merge into main until the Lead closes them.

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"os":"windows","project":"docs"}) In the docs project, writing files with PowerShell [IO.File]::WriteAllText using UTF8Encoding($false) writes content without a BOM so the first line stays exactly as specified.

[Lesson w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) When creating or editing any file under deliverables/ or reports/ in the docs project, put the 'Owner: docs-team' line first; otherwise the pre-merge check fails and the work is reopened.

[Fact w=1.00] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, every team document in deliverables/ or reports/ must name its owning team on its first line in the exact form 'Owner: <team>' (e.g. 'Owner: docs-team').
